rationale: Full three-lens review after rebase onto current main. AC1–AC7 satisfied. CR-001 (untyped parameter) and CR-002 (version service propagation) from the prior round are resolved in the rebased branch. CR-003 (workflow execution path) was deferred as out-of-scope per prior check round. EC-001 (virtual assistant no-op): _ask_virtual_assistant builds the assistant via model_construct which omits file_attachment_enabled, so the guard is always a no-op for virtual assistant requests — this is a pre-existing behaviour of ephemeral virtual assistants that never persist configuration, and the guard design is intentionally scoped to persistent assistants only; acceptable. AC8 partial: unit tests cover the validator in isolation (4 tests, all pass), but no HTTP-level integration tests exercise the guard through _ask_assistant or _ask_virtual_assistant call sites — gap is minor given the call sites are one-liners and the validator is well-covered. PATCH reset risk follows the existing pattern for nullable boolean fields. One deferred finding (EC-003/CR-003: workflow execution bypass) tracked for a follow-up ticket. Dismissed: PATCH reset minor note (follows existing project pattern for nullable boolean fields).

business_review.criterion: AC1 — file_attachment_enabled field on Assistant model with Optional[bool] default None
business_review.notes: SQLField(default=None, nullable=True) on AssistantBase and AssistantConfiguration.

business_review.criterion: AC2 — AssistantRequest includes field for create/update
business_review.notes: file_attachment_enabled: Optional[bool] = None present in AssistantRequest.

business_review.criterion: AC3 — HTTP 403 raised when enabled is False and files supplied
business_review.notes: _validate_file_attachment_allowed_and_raise raises ExtendedHTTPException(HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN) when file_attachment_enabled is False and file_names is non-empty.

business_review.criterion: AC4 — None (unset) allows file attachment (backward compatible)
business_review.notes: Guard uses identity check `is False`; None falls through without error.
Both call sites invoke _validate_file_attachment_allowed_and_raise before processing.

business_review.criterion: AC6 — Alembic migration adds column to assistants and assistant_configurations
business_review.notes: Migration u2v3w4x5y6z7 adds nullable boolean column to both tables. down_revision correctly set to b5c6d7e8f9a0.

business_review.criterion: AC7 — Version service propagates field through snapshot lifecycle
business_review.notes: create_initial_version, create_new_version, rollback, and update_assistant_config_fields all propagate file_attachment_enabled.

business_review.criterion: AC8 — Tests cover the guard and its call sites
business_review.notes: 4 unit tests cover the validator in isolation. No HTTP-level integration test exercises the guard through the router call sites. Gap is minor given one-liner call sites and complete validator coverage.

standards_review.notes: Commits follow EPMCDME-####: Description format consistent with project conventions.
Typed parameters, modern Optional syntax, Ruff formatting applied. No blocking quality issues.
HTTP 403 enforcement. Flag defaults to None (allow) — safe backward-compatible default. No secret handling, no auth bypass, no injection surface.
